summary: Congressional restrictions on D.C.'s local authority continue to be a focus of advocacy efforts, with recent opposition to National Guard presence in the District and renewed commitment from lawmakers to prioritize statehood. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no voting representation in Congress, and Congress can override any law the District passes.
